integrity: The effective axiom scheme, finite amalgam search bound, completeness argument, and proof-enumeration decision procedure were reconstructed separately. The source proves model companionship and the quantitative witness bounds; the decidability conclusion is derived here.
scientific_limitations: The decision procedure is an effectiveness result; no practical complexity bound is claimed.
The argument depends on explicit local-finiteness bounds for exponent-three groups and does not automatically generalize to other exponents.
No quantifier elimination, finite axiomatization, stability classification, or countable categoricity is asserted.
title: The exponent-three group model companion is decidable
